rules.name: MilliSec-001: New User Account Created
rules.logic: when the event(s) were detected by a Local/Remote collector and the event category for the event is 'User Account Management' and the event QID is '4720: A user account was created' and when the event matches this AQL query: SELECT QIDNAME(qid) as 'Event', username, sourceip from events where QIDNAME(qid) ilike '%created%' LAST 5 MINUTES
rules.response: Dispatch Offense, annotate with MITRE T1136.002

rules.name: MilliSec-002: User Added to Privileged Group
rules.logic: when the event(s) were detected by a Local/Remote collector and the event QID is one of the following: '4728: A member was added to a security-enabled global group', '4732: A member was added to a security-enabled local group', '4756: A member was added to a security-enabled universal group'
rules.response: Dispatch Offense, annotate with MITRE T1098.007

rules.name: MilliSec-003: Multiple Account Lockouts - Brute Force Pattern
rules.logic: when the event QID is '4740: A user account was locked out' and when the count of the matched events is greater than 3 in 10 minutes grouping by sourceip
rules.response: Dispatch Offense, annotate with MITRE T1110

rules.name: MilliSec-004: Suspicious PowerShell Encoded Command
rules.logic: when the event was detected by a Local/Remote collector and the event payload contains any of the following strings: '-enc', '-encodedcommand', '-w hidden', 'FromBase64String' and the process name is 'PowerShell.exe'
rules.response: Dispatch Offense, annotate with MITRE T1027

rules.name: MilliSec-005: Process Injection - CreateRemoteThread Detected
rules.logic: when the event QID is 'Sysmon Event ID 8: CreateRemoteThread detected' and the source process is not in the Reference Set 'Approved_Admin_Tools'
rules.response: Dispatch CRITICAL Offense, annotate with MITRE T1055

rules.name: MilliSec-006: LSASS Memory Access - Credential Dumping
rules.logic: when the event QID is 'Sysmon Event ID 10: ProcessAccess' and the target process is 'C:\Windows\system32\lsass.exe' and the granted access is '0x1010' or '0x1410' or '0x1438' and the source process is not 'C:\Windows\system32\wbem\wmiprvse.exe'
rules.response: Dispatch CRITICAL Offense, annotate with MITRE T1003.001

rules.name: MilliSec-007: RDP Lateral Movement - Multi-Host Logins
rules.logic: when the event QID is '4624: An account was successfully logged on' and the Logon Type is 10 (RemoteInteractive) and when the count of distinct destination IPs is greater than 2 grouping by username in 30 minutes
rules.response: Dispatch Offense, annotate with MITRE T1021.001

rules.name: MilliSec-008: Malicious DNS Request - Sinkhole Hit
rules.logic: when a DNS event matches an entry in the Reference Set 'Threat_Intel_Domains' or when the DNS response IP equals '0.0.0.0' (sinkhole)
rules.response: Dispatch Offense, annotate with MITRE T1071.004

rules.name: MilliSec-009: Suspicious Service Installation
rules.logic: when the event QID is '7045: A new service was installed in the system' and the service file name does not match any of the following patterns: 'C:\Windows\*', 'C:\Program Files\*'
rules.response: Dispatch Offense, annotate with MITRE T1543.003

rules.name: MilliSec-010: Malicious Email Attachment Quarantined
rules.logic: when the log source type is 'Mail Gateway' and the event payload contains 'Blocked INFECTED' or 'Blocked BANNED' and the attachment extension is one of: '.exe', '.scr', '.vbs', '.js', '.docm'
rules.response: Dispatch Offense, annotate with MITRE T1566.001
